A1.justification: Both PDFs describe VolSplat and contain readable methods, equations, experiments, figures, tables, and Appendices A–D. Content can be matched reliably despite extensive reformatting.

before.justification: v2 reports original reconstruction experiments on RealEstate10K, ScanNet, and ACID, component ablations, efficiency measurements, and qualitative results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in Tables 1–5 and A and the main-text and appendix visual comparisons.

M1.justification: Both versions retain the same depth-based feature lifting, voxel aggregation, sparse residual 3D U-Net, per-voxel Gaussian prediction, and combined MSE/LPIPS training objective.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation coverage remains RealEstate10K and ScanNet, with zero-shot evaluation on ACID and the same input-view scenarios. The added world-model references introduce no evaluated task or dataset.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–3 and A, including FreeSplat and FreeSplat++ in the ScanNet comparison. Newly cited methods such as WonderTurbo and TriSplat are not added to the reported evaluations.

E3.justification: Both versions specify the same splits, 256 × 256 resolution, 150,000 training iterations, six training input views, eight target views, and PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS metrics. The 6/12/24-view evaluations and 12-view ablation protocol also match.

E4.justification: The voxel-size and decoder ablations in Tables 4–5, Gaussian-density analysis in Figure 7, cross-dataset analysis, and Appendix B efficiency analysis are retained unchanged. Appendix D contains the same visual comparisons.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All values in Tables 1–5 and A match, as do the qualitative examples. For example, six-view RealEstate10K performance remains 31.30 PSNR, 0.941 SSIM, and 0.075 LPIPS; Appendix A's efficiency table retains 4.65 GB and 0.575 seconds.

T1.justification: Visual inspection confirms that Equations (1)–(10) retain the same mathematical content. No definition, formal assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or substantively revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the claims about voxel alignment, adaptive Gaussian density, multi-view consistency, and state-of-the-art benchmark performance. Brief world-model motivation does not redefine the central contribution.

C2.justification: The explanations of generalization, Gaussian allocation, refinement benefits, and pose-related baseline performance are unchanged. Appendix C retains the static-scene limitation, motion-induced ghosting/blurring, and societal-impact discussion.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix A retain the same implementation, hardware, learning rates, depth candidates, Gaussian parameterization, and sampling details. The project-page address and statements about supplementary source code and future release are also unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds nine references, including DriveGen3D, WonderTurbo, TriSplat, PanFlow, and World-R1, and briefly connects feed-forward reconstruction to world-model priors. The central positioning against pixel-aligned methods and EVolSplat remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 adds Jia-Wang Bian and the associated affiliation, expands front-matter metadata, makes brief world-model wording changes, and shortens Figure 1's caption. The main prose, section sequence, and appendix organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: The entire paper adopts a different page template and typography, with affiliation logos, a shaded abstract, and colored links. Figure 1 moves to the title page, and retained figures and tables are resized and repositioned throughout; their scientific content is preserved.

improvement.justification: v3 substantially restyles the document and modestly broadens its literature context, while preserving the method, results, technical explanations, reproducibility information, and limitations. Both versions are readable, and the changes establish no meaningful net gain or loss in the paper's scientific support or clarity.
